messages:
maria: Heads-up — while wiring the sampleapp to the new hosted API I hit a parity gap: the Node SDK doesn't expose the admin list endpoint we rely on (used to fetch org model metadata).

alex: which endpoint exactly? can you paste the curl you used?

maria: `GET /admin/models/list` — we call this from the onboarding flow to show available model variants. curl works fine: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/admin/models/list` returns the JSON we need.

sam: repro'd this. In the SDK there's only `listModels()` but it maps to `v1/models` and doesn't include the admin metadata (billing tiers, quant profiles).

maria: also spotted param name drift — REST expects `model_version` snake_case in filter, SDK uses `modelVersion` camelCase. That caused a silent fallback to latest version in sampleapp (very sneaky).

diana: ugh. Silent fallback is the worst for onboarding. Any idea which layer is swallowing the mismatch?

sam: looks like the client lib serializes camelCase and server accepts it but ignores unknown keys for admin route. So SDK call succeeds (200) but returns default set.

alex: can we add the admin endpoint to the SDK surface quickly? patch + minor release? Also standardize param mapping to allow both `modelVersion` and `model_version` as accepted aliases.

maria: happy to draft a test and sampleapp patch. Quick POC: in the sampleapp I added `model_version` to the SDK body and it worked. We should probably add a validation error server-side instead of silently returning defaults.

devex-bot: Created issue RDW-4592: "SDK: expose admin models list + param aliasing for model_version" — https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/issues/4592

diana: thanks bot :raised_hands: — Alex, can you own the SDK change? Sam — add a regression test in sampleapp e2e. Maria — patch sampleapp onboarding to surfacing a warning if model selection falls back.

alex: I can pick the SDK change. plan: add `admin.listModels()` mapping, update types, add a param normalizer that maps snake_case <-> camelCase for known admin filters. Will propose a PR by EOD tomorrow.

sam: will add an e2e test that asserts the admin metadata (quantization, costTier) is present; if not, fail. Also add a test that sending camelCase still works.

maria: one more wrinkle: streaming behavior differs between REST and SDK for the same `stream=true` flag — SDK emits chunks in larger batches (buffered) which impacted our progress bar in sampleapp. Not blocking but good to keep in the changelog.

diana: file that as a follow-up. can we put the streaming diff in the release notes under Known Issues so customers won't be surprised?

devex-bot: Linked RDW-4592 -> RDW-4601 (follow-up: streaming chunking parity).

maria: thanks all. I'll open the sampleapp PR with a short repro and link the issue.

alex: great. after SDK PR we'll publish a minor release and patch sampleapp. cc @platform-announce for rollout notes.

sam: if anyone needs a quick workaround, call the admin REST endpoint directly from sampleapp until the SDK patch lands. include the org API key header.

diana: recording action items: alex SDK PR, sam e2e coverage, maria sampleapp PR, platform to add server-side validation. Back here once PRs are up.

maria: pinging later with the PR link. thanks!
